Description: A person claims to own or manage a room and asks the student to pay a deposit or first month rent before reliable verification.
Red_Flags: Landlord cannot show the room live
Bank account name does not match landlord
Recommended_Actions: Ask for live viewing or trusted local verification
Report the listing to the platform

Description: A scammer pretends to be a student or housemate recruiting a new roommate and asks for a reservation fee.
Red_Flags: Fee requested to secure a place
Recommended_Actions: Ask to verify housemates through university email
Confirm the address and tenancy permission

Description: A person claims to temporarily sublet a student room but cannot prove they are the tenant or allowed to sublet.
Red_Flags: Deposit sent to a different name
Recommended_Actions: Request proof of permission to sublet
Do not accept no-registration explanations without checking local rules

Description: A scammer impersonates a group admin, student organization helper, or platform moderator to redirect students to a fake payment flow.
Recommended_Actions: Do not leave trusted platform workflows
Check with the university or student organization

Description: A fake or cloned agency advertises rooms and collects registration, reservation, or viewing fees from students.
Red_Flags: Guarantees that sound too good to be true
Recommended_Actions: Avoid upfront fees before a concrete verified rental
